headline: Anthropic's Consulting Arm Is Coming for Your Healthcare AI Engagements
summary: Anthropic launched a consulting arm this week, moving from model provider to direct competitor with advisory firms on AI strategy and implementation engagements. Forbes identified five structural shifts this creates for the consulting industry. The healthcare-specific risk is acute: Anthropic already has production deployments in Epic, clinical search, and claims automation at major health systems. Those account relationships are the natural entry point for consulting services. The structural conflict of interest (an advisory firm that can only recommend its own model) is a defensible positioning argument for independent consultants, but only if you use it proactively before Anthropic is already on the shortlist.
so_what: Anthropic is no longer just a model company. They are standing up advisory services that will compete directly with consulting firms on AI strategy and implementation, including in healthcare.
original_title: Anthropic Launched A Consulting Arm. 5 Ways The Industry Has To Change
